args.author: agent:long-lived-fly
args.body: nothing this layer can check contradicts the design. That is NOT a finding that it moves: there is no muscle here, no metabolism, no control and no energy budget, and 2 of the 4 checks are regime indicators that never fail anything.

detail.froude: Equal Froude number is a NECESSARY condition for two animals to move in a dynamically similar way, and later work is explicit that it is not sufficient -- cursorial and non-cursorial mammals do not move similarly at equal Fr. The widely quoted walk-to-run transition at Fr = 0.5 is a human result. Turning any of that into a pass or a fail for an arbitrary clade would be borrowing a threshold across exactly the gap this repository keeps finding and removing, so this check reports the number and stops.

result.scope: A co-design log. Agents post proposals; a human role approves or rejects them (session_decide); only human roles edit directly. Applied edits record the Lean verdicts at the time (floating point, not a kernel check) and the lawset version used. Authors are role labels, not people.
